catalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE dbo.catalog_parent(a INT NOT NULL,b INT NOT NULL,label NVARCHAR(40),CONSTRAINT PK_catalog_parent PRIMARY KEY(a,b),CONSTRAINT UQ_catalog_parent_label UNIQUE(label));
CREATE TABLE dbo.catalog_child(a INT NOT NULL,b INT NOT NULL,state BIT CONSTRAINT DF_catalog_child_state DEFAULT(1),doubled AS(a*2) PERSISTED,CONSTRAINT PK_catalog_child PRIMARY KEY(a,b),CONSTRAINT FK_catalog_child_parent FOREIGN KEY(a,b) REFERENCES dbo.catalog_parent(a,b) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT CK_catalog_child_a CHECK(a>0)); CREATE INDEX IX_catalog_parent_label ON dbo.catalog_parent(label); CREATE TABLE dbo.catalog_rename_target(id INT,label NVARCHAR(20));
CREATE VIEW dbo.catalog_view AS SELECT a,b,label FROM dbo.catalog_parent
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.catalog_proc AS SELECT a,b FROM dbo.catalog_parent
CREATE TRIGGER dbo.catalog_trigger ON dbo.catalog_child AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; END

SELECT name,RTRIM(type) AS type,type_desc,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS parent FROM sys.objects WHERE parent_object_id IN(OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_parent'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_child')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name,RTRIM(type) AS type,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS parent,unique_index_id,is_system_named FROM sys.key_constraints WHERE parent_object_id IN(OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_parent'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_child')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS child,OBJECT_NAME(referenced_object_id) AS parent,key_index_id,is_disabled,is_not_for_replication,is_not_trusted,delete_referential_action,delete_referential_action_desc,update_referential_action,update_referential_action_desc,is_system_named FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE name='FK_catalog_child_parent'

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(constraint_object_id) AS name,constraint_column_id,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS child,COL_NAME(parent_object_id,parent_column_id) AS child_column,OBJECT_NAME(referenced_object_id) AS parent,COL_NAME(referenced_object_id,referenced_column_id) AS parent_column FROM sys.foreign_key_columns WHERE constraint_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.FK_catalog_child_parent') ORDER BY constraint_column_id
SELECT name,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS parent,parent_column_id,definition,is_system_named FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE name='DF_catalog_child_state'

SELECT name,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS parent,parent_column_id,definition,is_disabled,is_not_for_replication,is_not_trusted,uses_database_collation,is_system_named FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name='CK_catalog_child_a'
SELECT name,RTRIM(type) AS type,type_desc,is_auto_executed,is_execution_replicated,is_repl_serializable_only,skips_repl_constraints FROM sys.procedures WHERE name='catalog_proc'

SELECT name,parent_class,parent_class_desc,OBJECT_NAME(parent_id) AS parent,RTRIM(type) AS type,type_desc,is_ms_shipped,is_disabled,is_not_for_replication,is_instead_of_trigger FROM sys.triggers WHERE name='catalog_trigger'
SELECT file_id,type,type_desc,data_space_id,name,state,state_desc,max_size,growth,is_percent_growth FROM sys.database_files ORDER BY file_id
SELECT name,index_id,is_unique,is_primary_key,is_unique_constraint FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_parent') ORDER BY index_id
SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,max_length FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.catalog_rename_target') ORDER BY column_id

definitions.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.definition_defaults(d_positive INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_positive DEFAULT(1),d_negative INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_negative DEFAULT(-1),d_zeros INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_zeros DEFAULT(0001),d_decimal DECIMAL(10,2) CONSTRAINT DF_definition_decimal DEFAULT(1.25),d_exponent FLOAT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_exponent DEFAULT(1e2),d_string VARCHAR(30) CONSTRAINT DF_definition_string DEFAULT('a''b'),d_unicode NVARCHAR(30) CONSTRAINT DF_definition_unicode DEFAULT(N'a''b'),d_null INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_null DEFAULT(NULL),d_clock DATETIME CONSTRAINT DF_definition_clock DEFAULT(GETDATE()),d_cast BIGINT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_cast DEFAULT(CAST(1 AS BIGINT)),d_convert INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_convert DEFAULT(CONVERT(INT,'2')),d_uuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER CONSTRAINT DF_definition_uuid DEFAULT(NEWID()),d_binary VARBINARY(4) CONSTRAINT DF_definition_binary DEFAULT(0x01),d_sum INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_sum DEFAULT(1+2),d_nested INT CONSTRAINT DF_definition_nested DEFAULT((((1)))))

CREATE TABLE dbo.definition_computed(a INT NOT NULL,b INT NULL,label VARCHAR(20),c_multiply AS(a*2),c_add AS(a+2),c_nested AS(a*(b+1)),c_divide AS(a/2),c_coalesce AS(COALESCE(b,0)),c_cast AS(CAST(a AS BIGINT)),c_isnull AS(ISNULL(b,0)),c_case AS(CASE WHEN a>0 THEN a ELSE 0 END),c_lower AS(LOWER(label)))
SELECT name,parent_column_id,definition,is_system_named FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.definition_defaults') ORDER BY parent_column_id

SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,user_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,is_nullable,definition,uses_database_collation,is_persisted FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.definition_computed') ORDER BY column_id

CREATE TABLE dbo.namespace_defaults(id INT CONSTRAINT DF_namespace DEFAULT(1))

CREATE TABLE dbo.namespace_view(id INT CONSTRAINT DF_namespace DEFAULT(1))
CREATE TABLE dbo.namespace_failed(id INT CONSTRAINT DF_namespace DEFAULT(1))

CREATE TABLE dbo.namespace_failed_key(id INT CONSTRAINT PK_namespace DEFAULT(1))
CREATE TABLE dbo.namespace_check(id INT CONSTRAINT CK_namespace CHECK(id>0))

v2.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_checks_a(a INT,b INT,c INT,s VARCHAR(20),n NVARCHAR(20),d DATETIME,m DECIMAL(10,2),CONSTRAINT k01 CHECK (a IN (1,2,3)),CONSTRAINT k02 CHECK (s IN ('x','y')),CONSTRAINT k03 CHECK (s LIKE 'a%'),CONSTRAINT k04 CHECK (a BETWEEN 1 AND 10),CONSTRAINT k05 CHECK (a > 0 AND b < 5),CONSTRAINT k06 CHECK ((a > 0 OR b > 0) AND a <> 3),CONSTRAINT k07 CHECK (NOT a = 1),CONSTRAINT k08 CHECK (a IS NOT NULL),CONSTRAINT k09 CHECK (b IS NULL OR b >= a),CONSTRAINT k10 CHECK (len(s) > 2),CONSTRAINT k11 CHECK (upper(s) = s),CONSTRAINT k12 CHECK (a % 2 = 0),CONSTRAINT k13 CHECK (a != 4),CONSTRAINT k14 CHECK (d < dateadd(day, 1, getdate())),CONSTRAINT k15 CHECK (-a < 0),CONSTRAINT k16 CHECK (s + 'x' <> 'yx'),CONSTRAINT k17 CHECK (a NOT IN (7,8)),CONSTRAINT k18 CHECK (a NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 200),CONSTRAINT k19 CHECK (s NOT LIKE 'z%'),CONSTRAINT k20 CHECK (m > 1.5 AND m < -2.25e1),CONSTRAINT k21 CHECK (CASE a WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1),CONSTRAINT k22 CHECK (CAST(s AS INT) > 0),CONSTRAINT k23 CHECK (CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d, 120) > '2000'),CONSTRAINT k24 CHECK (n = N'abc'),CONSTRAINT k25 CHECK (a & 1 = 0),CONSTRAINT k26 CHECK (CAST(a AS DECIMAL(5,2)) > 0 AND CAST(s AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) <> '' AND CAST(d AS DATETIME2(3)) > '2000-01-01'),CONSTRAINT k27 CHECK (datediff(day, d, getdate()) < 5 AND year(d) > 2000),CONSTRAINT k29 CHECK (coalesce(a, b, 0) >= 0 AND isnull(b, 0) >= 0 AND nullif(a, 0) > 0),CONSTRAINT k30 CHECK (s LIKE '%[0-9]%' ESCAPE '\'),CONSTRAINT k31 CHECK ([a] > (0)),CONSTRAINT k32 CHECK (a = 1 OR a = 2 OR a = 3),CONSTRAINT k34 CHECK (a > 0 AND (b > 0 OR s IS NULL) AND (b < 10 OR a < 5)),CONSTRAINT k35 CHECK (lower(s) = 'x' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN),CONSTRAINT k36 CHECK (a = +1),CONSTRAINT k37 CHECK (~a = 0),CONSTRAINT k38 CHECK (a * (b + 1) - 2 / (a - 1) > 0),CONSTRAINT k40 CHECK (s = 'it''s'),CONSTRAINT k42 CHECK (a = 0x10),CONSTRAINT k43 CHECK (TRY_CAST(s AS INT) IS NOT NULL),CONSTRAINT k44 CHECK (iif(a > 0, 1, 0) = 1))

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_checks_b(a INT,b INT,c INT,s VARCHAR(20),n NVARCHAR(20),d DATETIME,m DECIMAL(10,2),CONSTRAINT k45 CHECK (left(s, 2) = 'ab' AND substring(s, 1, 2) = 'ab' AND charindex('a', s) > 0 AND ltrim(rtrim(s)) <> '' AND replace(s, 'a', 'b') <> ''),CONSTRAINT k46 CHECK (abs(a) < 10 AND round(m, 1) > 0 AND power(a, 2) < 100),CONSTRAINT k47 CHECK (a IN (1)),CONSTRAINT k48 CHECK (CAST(a AS BIT) = 1 AND CAST(a AS FLOAT) > 0 AND CAST(a AS VARCHAR) <> '' AND CAST(d AS DATE) > '2000' AND CAST(a AS NUMERIC) > 0),CONSTRAINT k49 CHECK (a = 1.0 AND m = 0.50 AND m = .5 AND m = 5. AND a = 1e0 AND a = 2147483648 AND a = -0),CONSTRAINT k50 CHECK (a - (b - c) > 0),CONSTRAINT k51 CHECK ((a - b) - c > 0),CONSTRAINT k52 CHECK (a + b + c > 0),CONSTRAINT k53 CHECK (a * b * c > 0),CONSTRAINT k54 CHECK (a / (b * c) > 0),CONSTRAINT k55 CHECK ((a + b) * c > 0),CONSTRAINT k56 CHECK (a = b + c),CONSTRAINT k57 CHECK (a + b = c),CONSTRAINT k58 CHECK (a = b),CONSTRAINT k59 CHECK (a = (b)),CONSTRAINT k60 CHECK (((a > 0))),CONSTRAINT k61 CHECK (a > 0 OR b > 0 OR c > 0),CONSTRAINT k62 CHECK (a > 0 AND b > 0 OR c > 0),CONSTRAINT k63 CHECK (a > 0 AND (b > 0 OR c > 0)),CONSTRAINT k64 CHECK (NOT (a > 0 AND b > 0)),CONSTRAINT k65 CHECK (a IN (1, b, c + 1)),CONSTRAINT k66 CHECK (-(a + b) < 0),CONSTRAINT k67 CHECK (a - -1 > 0),CONSTRAINT k68 CHECK (s + 'x' + s <> 'y'),CONSTRAINT k69 CHECK (a | b ^ c > 0),CONSTRAINT k70 CHECK (a NOT IN (1) AND NOT (a IN (2,3))),CONSTRAINT q01 CHECK (-(a*b) < 0),CONSTRAINT q03 CHECK (a*-b < 0),CONSTRAINT q04 CHECK (~(a+b) = 0),CONSTRAINT q05 CHECK (abs(a+b) < 10 AND isnull(a+1,0) > 0 AND abs(a*b) < 5),CONSTRAINT q06 CHECK (CAST(a+1 AS bigint) > 0 AND CAST(a*2 AS bigint) > 0),CONSTRAINT q07 CHECK (CASE WHEN a+1>0 THEN a+1 ELSE a*2 END > 0),CONSTRAINT q08 CHECK ((a > 0 AND b > 0) AND c > 0),CONSTRAINT q09 CHECK (a > 0 OR (b > 0 OR c > 0)),CONSTRAINT q10 CHECK (a BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND b > 0),CONSTRAINT q11 CHECK (a IN (1,2) AND b > 0),CONSTRAINT q12 CHECK (b > 0 OR a IN (1,2)),CONSTRAINT q13 CHECK (NOT (a IS NULL)),CONSTRAINT q14 CHECK (NOT NOT a > 0),CONSTRAINT q15 CHECK (a BETWEEN b+1 AND c*2))

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_checks_c(a INT,b INT,c INT,s VARCHAR(20),n NVARCHAR(20),d DATETIME,m DECIMAL(10,2),CONSTRAINT q16 CHECK (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), a) <> '' AND CONVERT(VARBINARY(MAX), s) <> 0x AND CONVERT(CHAR(1), s) <> '' AND CONVERT(TIME(7), d) > '00:00' AND CONVERT(FLOAT(53), a) > 0 AND CONVERT(REAL, a) > 0 AND CONVERT(SMALLINT,a) > 0 AND CONVERT(TINYINT,a) >= 0 AND CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET(2), d) > '2000' AND CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, s) IS NULL AND CONVERT(MONEY, a) > 0 AND CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, d) > '2000' AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), a) <> '' AND CONVERT(DECIMAL, a) > 0 AND CONVERT(NCHAR(2), s) <> '' AND CONVERT(BINARY(4), a) <> 0x00 AND CONVERT(DECIMAL(5), a) > 0),CONSTRAINT q17 CHECK (s COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS = 'x'),CONSTRAINT q18 CHECK (a > 0 AND s LIKE 'x%' AND b IS NULL),CONSTRAINT q19 CHECK (CASE WHEN a > 0 AND b > 0 THEN 1 WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 END = 1),CONSTRAINT q20 CHECK (dateadd(month, -1, d) < d AND datepart(dw, d) > 0 AND datename(month, d) <> '' AND eomonth(d) > d),CONSTRAINT q21 CHECK (a = 1 AND b = 2 OR a = 3 AND b = 4),CONSTRAINT q22 CHECK (s = '' AND s <> N'' AND s IS NOT NULL),CONSTRAINT q23 CHECK (a > b - 1),CONSTRAINT q24 CHECK (a - 1 > b),CONSTRAINT q25 CHECK (a + b * c > 0),CONSTRAINT q26 CHECK (a * b + c > 0),CONSTRAINT q27 CHECK (a % b * c > 0),CONSTRAINT q28 CHECK (len(s + 'x') > 0),CONSTRAINT q29 CHECK (a > 0 AND NOT b > 0),CONSTRAINT q30 CHECK (try_convert(int, s) > 0),CONSTRAINT q31 CHECK (concat(s, 'x', a) <> '' AND iif(a > 0, 'y', 'n') = 'y'),CONSTRAINT q32 CHECK (cast(cast(a AS bigint) AS int) > 0))

SELECT name,definition,uses_database_collation FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_checks_a'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_checks_b'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_checks_c')) ORDER BY name
SELECT name,OBJECT_DEFINITION(object_id) AS definition FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_checks_a') ORDER BY name

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_defaults(a1 DATETIME DEFAULT (getutcdate()),a2 NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT suser_sname(),a3 VARCHAR(5) DEFAULT '',a4 NVARCHAR(5) DEFAULT N'',a5 DECIMAL(5,1) DEFAULT 0.0,a6 DECIMAL(5,1) DEFAULT -1.5,a7 INT DEFAULT (0),a9 DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,a10 VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'abc' + 'd',a11 INT DEFAULT 1 * 2,a12 INT DEFAULT -(1),a13 INT DEFAULT 1 + 2 * 3,a14 BIT DEFAULT 0,a15 FLOAT DEFAULT 1.5e0,a16 DATETIME2 DEFAULT sysutcdatetime(),a17 INT DEFAULT NULL,a18 VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT (('x')),a19 INT DEFAULT ((1)+(2)),a20 BIGINT DEFAULT 9223372036854775807,a21 INT DEFAULT +5,a23 DATE DEFAULT '2020-01-01',a24 INT DEFAULT 1 - 2 - 3,a25 INT DEFAULT 2 * (3 + 4),named INT CONSTRAINT DF_v2_named DEFAULT 7)

SELECT c.name AS column_name,LEFT(d.name,4) AS prefix,d.definition,d.is_system_named,COLUMNPROPERTY(d.parent_object_id,c.name,'ColumnId') AS column_id FROM sys.default_constraints d JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=d.parent_object_id AND c.column_id=d.parent_column_id WHERE d.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_defaults') ORDER BY d.parent_column_id

CREATE TABLE dbo.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz(colabcdefghij INT DEFAULT 1, c INT DEFAULT 2, ccccc INT DEFAULT 3, cccccc INT DEFAULT 4); CREATE TABLE dbo.t(colabcdefghij INT DEFAULT 1, c INT DEFAULT 2); CREATE TABLE dbo.tabletwelve(colabcdefghij INT DEFAULT 1, ab INT DEFAULT 2)

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS table_name,COL_NAME(parent_object_id,parent_column_id) AS column_name,LEFT(name,LEN(name)-8) AS prefix,LEN(name) AS length FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.t'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.tabletwelve'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_defaults')) ORDER BY table_name,parent_column_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS linked FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.default_constraints d ON d.object_id=c.default_object_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_defaults')

CREATE TABLE dbo.ck_parent(id INT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE dbo.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_ck(colabcdefghij INT CHECK (colabcdefghij > 0), y INT CHECK (y > 0), z INT, refabcdefghij INT REFERENCES dbo.ck_parent(id), r INT REFERENCES dbo.ck_parent(id), CHECK (z > 0 AND y > 0))

SELECT RTRIM(type) AS type,LEFT(name,LEN(name)-8) AS prefix,LEN(name) AS length FROM sys.objects WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_ck') AND RTRIM(type) IN ('C','F') ORDER BY prefix

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_alter(id INT, v INT); ALTER TABLE dbo.v2_alter ADD CONSTRAINT DF_v2_alter_v DEFAULT (5) FOR v; ALTER TABLE dbo.v2_alter ADD w INT DEFAULT -2; ALTER TABLE dbo.v2_alter ADD DEFAULT 9 FOR id

SELECT COL_NAME(parent_object_id,parent_column_id) AS column_name,CASE WHEN is_system_named=1 THEN LEFT(name,13) ELSE name END AS name,definition,is_system_named FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_alter') ORDER BY parent_column_id

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_computed(a INT NOT NULL,b INT,s VARCHAR(10),d DATETIME,x1 AS a + b,x2 AS (a * b) PERSISTED,x4 AS CAST(a AS VARCHAR(10)),x5 AS -a,x6 AS a,x7 AS 1,x8 AS year(d),x9 AS ISNULL(b, a) PERSISTED NOT NULL,x10 AS CASE WHEN a IN (1,2) THEN 1 END)

SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,is_nullable,definition,is_persisted,uses_database_collation FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_computed') ORDER BY column_id
CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_computed_text(s VARCHAR(10),x3 AS s + 'x')
SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,max_length,is_nullable,definition FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_computed_text') ORDER BY column_id

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_l1(id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_v2_l1 PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED, code INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_v2_l1 UNIQUE CLUSTERED); CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_l2(a INT NOT NULL, b INT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_v2_l2 PRIMARY KEY (a DESC, b), CONSTRAINT uq_v2_l2 UNIQUE (b DESC)); CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_l3(a INT NOT NULL, b INT NOT NULL); ALTER TABLE dbo.v2_l3 ADD CONSTRAINT pk_v2_l3 PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (a), CONSTRAINT uq_v2_l3 UNIQUE CLUSTERED (b DESC)

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name,name,index_id,type,type_desc,is_unique,is_primary_key,is_unique_constraint FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l1'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l2'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l3')) ORDER BY table_name,index_id

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name,index_id,index_column_id,COL_NAME(object_id,column_id) AS column_name,key_ordinal,is_descending_key,is_included_column FROM sys.index_columns WHERE object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l1'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l2'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l3')) ORDER BY table_name,index_id,index_column_id

SELECT name,OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS table_name,unique_index_id,is_system_named,is_enforced FROM sys.key_constraints WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l1'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l2'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_l3')) ORDER BY name
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.v2_proc @a INT = 5, @b NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT, @c DECIMAL(10,2), @d VARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @e DATETIME2(3) = '2000-01-01' AS SELECT @a
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.v2_scalar(@x INT, @y VARCHAR(10) = 'q') RETURNS BIGINT AS BEGIN RETURN @x END
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.v2_inline(@x INT) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN SELECT @x AS v
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.v2_table(@x INT) RETURNS @t TABLE(v INT) AS BEGIN INSERT @t VALUES(@x); RETURN END
CREATE TRIGGER dbo.v2_trg ON dbo.v2_tt INSTEAD OF INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON
CREATE VIEW dbo.v2_view AS SELECT id FROM dbo.v2_tt

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS module,name,parameter_id,system_type_id,user_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,is_output,is_cursor_ref,has_default_value,is_xml_document,default_value,xml_collection_id,is_readonly,is_nullable FROM sys.parameters WHERE object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_proc'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_scalar'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_inline'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_table')) ORDER BY module,parameter_id

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS module,definition,uses_ansi_nulls,uses_quoted_identifier,is_schema_bound,uses_database_collation,is_recompiled,null_on_null_input,execute_as_principal_id,uses_native_compilation,inline_type,is_inlineable FROM sys.sql_modules WHERE object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_proc'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_scalar'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_inline'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_table'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_trg'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_view')) ORDER BY module
SELECT name,parent_class,parent_class_desc,OBJECT_NAME(parent_id) AS parent,type,type_desc,is_ms_shipped,is_disabled,is_not_for_replication,is_instead_of_trigger FROM sys.triggers WHERE name='v2_trg'

SELECT OBJECT_DEFINITION(OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_tt')) AS table_definition,OBJECT_DEFINITION(OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_trg')) AS trigger_definition,OBJECT_DEFINITION(-1) AS missing,OBJECT_DEFINITION(NULL) AS null_id,OBJECT_DEFINITION(OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_view')) AS view_definition,OBJECT_DEFINITION(OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_scalar')) AS function_definition

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_p(a INT NOT NULL, b INT NOT NULL, u INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT UQ_v2_p_u UNIQUE, CONSTRAINT PK_v2_p PRIMARY KEY (b, a)); CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_f(x INT, y INT, z INT CONSTRAINT FK_v2_f_u REFERENCES dbo.v2_p(u) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT FK_v2_f_p FOREIGN KEY (y, x) REFERENCES dbo.v2_p(b, a) ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT)
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_pkeys 'v2_p', 'dbo', 'master'; SELECT @r AS status
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_fkeys NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL; SELECT @r AS status
SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC sp_pkeys 'v2_p'; EXEC sp_fkeys 'v2_p'; SET NOCOUNT OFF
BEGIN TRY EXEC sp_pkeys 'v2_p', 'dbo', 'master' END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS number END CATCH

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_rp(id INT CONSTRAINT PK_v2_rp PRIMARY KEY, code INT CONSTRAINT UQ_v2_rp UNIQUE, v INT CONSTRAINT CK_v2_rp_v CHECK (v > 0), w INT CONSTRAINT DF_v2_rp_w DEFAULT 1, z INT, y INT, cz AS z * 2); CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_rc(id INT, rp_id INT CONSTRAINT FK_v2_rc_rp REFERENCES dbo.v2_rp(id)); CREATE INDEX IX_v2_rp_y ON dbo.v2_rp(y)
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_rename 'dbo.v2_rp.cz', 'cz2', 'COLUMN'; SELECT @r AS status
SELECT name,type FROM sys.objects WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_rp3') OR object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_rp3') ORDER BY name
SELECT name,index_id,type_desc FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_rp3') ORDER BY index_id
SELECT name,column_id FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.v2_rp3') ORDER BY column_id
INSERT dbo.v2_rp3(id2,code2,v,y2,z) VALUES(1,2,3,4,5); INSERT dbo.v2_rc(id,rp_id2) VALUES(1,1); SELECT id2,code2,v,w2,y2,z,cz FROM dbo.v2_rp3
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_rename 'dbo.v2_rp3', ''; SELECT @r AS status
SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE name LIKE '%v2_rc4%'
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_rename 'dbo.v2_missing', 'v2_x'; SELECT @r AS status
BEGIN TRY EXEC sp_rename 'dbo.v2_missing', 'v2_x' END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS number END CATCH
CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_fi(id INT, v INT, code INT); CREATE INDEX ix_v2_fi ON dbo.v2_fi(code) WHERE v > 0
DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_rename 'dbo.v2_fi.v', 'v2', 'COLUMN'; SELECT @r AS status
SELECT name,filter_definition FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='ix_v2_fi'

CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_ist(a INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_v2_ist PRIMARY KEY, b NVARCHAR(20) CONSTRAINT DF_v2_ist_b DEFAULT N'x', c VARCHAR(MAX), d DECIMAL(10,2), e FLOAT, f REAL, g DATETIME2(3), h DATETIME, i BIT, j MONEY, k VARBINARY(10), m CHAR(3), o TIME(4), p UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, q TINYINT, r DATE, s NUMERIC(5), t AS a*2, CONSTRAINT UQ_v2_ist UNIQUE (d DESC, e), CONSTRAINT CK_v2_ist CHECK (a > 0)); CREATE TABLE dbo.v2_isf(x INT, y INT CONSTRAINT FK_v2_isf REFERENCES dbo.v2_ist(a) ON DELETE CASCADE)
SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('v2_ist','v2_isf','v2_view2') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
